chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibn Bukayr, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:
Do not enter your houses in Makkah when you are performing Ziyarah (visiting the Kaaba) — meaning the inhabitants of Makkah.
ai.seo_question: What is the etiquette for visitors to Makkah regarding entering their homes while performing Ziyarah?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises visitors to Makkah not to enter their own homes after performing Ziyarah, emphasizing a state of spiritual continuity and reverence for the sacred precincts. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining the sanctity of the pilgrimage experience, discouraging the immediate transition back to mundane domestic life, thereby preserving the spiritual elevation achieved through the ritual visit.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Ali, from Ibn Bukeyr, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not enter your houses in Makkah when you are Ziyarah (the Kabah)’ - meaning the inhabitants of Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ibn Bukayr from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not enter your lodgings when you visit the House, meaning thereby people of Makkah.’”
